essential_subset: emit sqlite_tx_begin only at false-to-true sqlite3.Connection.in_transaction edge
emit commit_end and rollback_end on the existing connection lifecycle stream
bounded payload-free lifecycle parser for WAL attribution candidates
excluded_as_unrelated: application write-lock ordering and timeout exception changes

contract.identity_owner: existing open event: UUID connection_id, PID, caller, purpose, thread/task ownership
contract.transaction_state: sqlite_tx_begin then commit_end, rollback_end, or close
contract.classification: read_only connection mode supports only READ_TRANSACTION_CANDIDATE; no active transaction proves a WAL pin
contract.duration: provenance parser derives transaction age from bounded event timestamps

bounded_storage.lifecycle_stream: existing rotating JSONL, default 10 MiB current plus two 10 MiB backups = 30 MiB maximum per configured path
bounded_storage.provenance_read: tail-read maximum 4 MiB; no output file

worker_compatibility.creator_funding: existing critical gate now captures a full checkpoint sample, existing lsof handle PIDs, and bounded lifecycle provenance; the existing busy threshold and self-exit are unchanged
worker_compatibility.creator_resolution: existing critical gate now supplies its existing checkpoint/stall sample plus bounded lsof PID provenance; the existing threshold, heartbeat, and self-exit are unchanged
worker_compatibility.watchdog_threads: no new watchdog or worker instance; collector is invoked only within each existing critical diagnostic branch

composition.claim_boundary: Neither an open descriptor nor an active read transaction is represented as a proven WAL pin.

qualification.command: python -m py_compile src/utils/db_locking.py src/utils/wal_watchdog_provenance.py src/core/creator_funding_worker.py src/core/creator_resolution_worker.py && pytest -q tests/test_x78_minimal_transaction_lifecycle.py tests/test_x78_13_autocommit_write_lane.py tests/test_x77_5_execute_script_commit_leak.py
